newsitem.title: ITALY: Gemina holds special board meeting Friday.
newsitem.headline: Gemina holds special board meeting Friday.

text.p: Italian financial holding group Gemina said it will hold an extraordinary board meeting on Friday, but it would not be discussing acquisitions, a Gemina spokeswoman said.

Gemina shares rose sharply on the Milan stock exchange in heavy trading on Thursday on rumours of a possible announcement of an investment operation. The stock closed 6.56 percent up at 760.2 lire on volume of nearly 38 million shares.
Traders said this morning that the renewed interest in the group stemmed from expectations of news from a meeting with financial analysts pencilled in for Wednesday and then put off.
